notes:
Summary: Copperline ArchiveGrid is an enterprise archival/search platform for regulated industries (financial/legal records). Primary interest: massive-scale RAG pipeline — embeddings + lightweight neural reranker. Target scale: 100M–1B vectors (first phase: 500M).

Key constraints / asks:
- Latency: p95 end-to-end rerank (embedding lookup + top-k rerank) target <= 200ms for 1k-1.2k QPS; preferred p95 <= 150ms for hot slices.
- Throughput: sustain bursts to 2k QPS for search frontends during peak windows.
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per query <$0.005 (aggressive), ideally ~$0.001–0.003 at steady state. Looking for batching + KV/prefix caching to get unit cost down.
- Indexing: initial backfill of ~500M vectors over 6 weeks; ongoing daily delta ~3–5M vectors. Need incremental ingest with low GC/compaction overhead.
- Models: open-weight embeddings preferred (cost control). Reranker: smaller cross-encoder (<500M params) for quality/latency tradeoff. Need model pinning + fallback to cheaper quantized variant.
- Deployment: VPC-first; customer wants private control plane and option for on-prem air-gapped later for EMEA legal entity. KMS integration mandatory.
- Security: must meet SOC2 + ISO27001; SSO/SAML, audit logging, retention controls, explicit data residency (EU) for subset.

Quotes & call notes:
- CTO: "We can tolerate slightly higher recall if it means 2x lower cost on cold queries — caching will be critical."
- Head of Search Ops: "If we can get predictable $/query at 500M vectors, procurement will approve a 12-month commit."
- SE feedback: "Batching of embed lookups + hot-key cache for top-K reduces GPU token work; recommend dedicated GPUs with autoscaling and local KV cache nodes."

POC specifics / success metrics:
- Ingest speed: 10M vectors/day sustained to hit 500M in window.
- Query costs: measured end-to-end cost per query (including embed lookup + rerank) must be <= $0.003 in optimized config.
- Latency: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 200ms at 1k sustained QPS.
- Quality: reranker NDCG@10 within 3% of their internal baseline.

Open items / blockers:
- Legal wants explicit data residency/legal language in SOW (blocker).
- Need quantization validation on their candidate reranker models (SE task).
- Budget approval timing: finance Q3 commit window (procurement risk).

Next steps (short):
- 72hr scale sweep (Aisha/Marco/Lena) — attempt ingestion to 500M (staged) + run cost matrix.
- Provide KMS/HSM diagram and addendum for data residency to SOW.
- Deliver quantized model test harness + compare accuracy vs fp16.
- Align on forecasted commit size and discount structure (pricing follow-up).

Linked artifacts: pricing deck, security answers, POC plan, Fireflies transcripts.
